dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderate concave curvature on the trailing edge spline between the apex and the posterior base.

dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 50-degree anterior margin steepness relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.3:1 ratio of maximum base width to maximum vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle at the pixel coordinate where the melon slope meets the rostrum.
